title: Kernel or filesystem driver service creation via EventID 7045
author: Adama ASSIONGBON (SOC & CTI Consultant), https://linkedin.com/in/adama-assiongbon-9029893a
description: Detects creation of a kernel driver or file system driver service (EID 7045, Windows System log). Covers rootkit persistence and BYOVD; adds file system driver type and user-writable ImagePath to catch evasion variants missed by kernel driver type alone.
